# Rivu CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `rivu docs --dir docs`. Edit internal/cli/cliref.md (the
intro) or the command code, then rerun — never edit this file by hand. -->

Scripting reference for `rivu`. The command help (`rivu <cmd> --help`) and
this file are written from the same source of truth: the code.

## Scripting contract

- **stdout = data only.** Everything a script wants to parse goes to stdout.
- **stderr = messages.** Warnings, diagnostics and errors go to stderr.
- **Exit codes**

  | Code | Meaning |
  |---|---|
  | 0 | success |
  | 1 | error |
  | 2 | usage error (bad flag, bad argument count) |
  | 3 | not found / ambiguous project |
  | 4 | needs `--yes` (Plan → confirm → Apply gate) |
  | 5 | warnings (output is still valid — e.g. scan warnings, below `--min-score`) |

- **`--json` output has `"schema": 1`.** Fields may be added within
  schema 1; existing fields keep their meaning. Arrays are `[]` when
  empty, never `null`.

## Global flags

Usable on every command, before or after the subcommand
(`rivu --json list` ≡ `rivu list --json`):

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--home DIR` | Rivu home for this run (overrides `RIVU_HOME`) |
| `--config FILE` | Config file for this run (overrides `RIVU_CONFIG`) |
| `--json` | JSON output **where the command supports it** (below) |
| `--no-color` | Force the no-colour profile (same as `NO_COLOR=1`) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Print config path and workspace root to stderr |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress `warning:` notes on stderr; exit codes still report them |
| `--yes`, `-y` | Skip confirmation prompts |
| `--dry-run` | Preview the change; write nothing |

## JSON output (`--json`, schema 1)

### `rivu version --json`

```json
{"schema":1,"version":"v1.0.0","commit":"abc1234","date":"2026-10-05","go":"go1.26.4","os":"windows","arch":"amd64"}
```

### `rivu list --json`

Filter flags (`--flow`, `--lang`, `--unhealthy`, `--stale`,
`--confluence`, `--sort`) apply to the array.

```json
{"schema":1,"projects":[
  {"id":"…","name":"demo","slug":"demo","path":"C:\\ws\\00_Source\\demo",
   "channel":"00_Source","flow_stage":"source","language":"go",
   "stack":["go"],"health_score":72,"has_git":true,"has_bank":true,
   "has_map":true,"created_at":"2026-10-01T12:00:00Z",
   "last_opened_at":"2026-10-04T09:30:00Z"}]}
```

`language`, `stack`, `last_opened_at` are omitted when unset.

### `rivu scan --json`

```json
{"schema":1,"root":"C:\\ws","projects":[…],"warnings":[],
 "missing":[],"unregistered":[],"stage_mismatch":[]}
```

- `projects` — every project found on disk (same objects as `list`).
- `warnings` — non-fatal scan notes (exit 5 when non-empty).
- `missing` — slugs in the registry with no folder.
- `unregistered` — folders with a strong marker not yet in the registry.
- `stage_mismatch` — slugs whose folder channel and flow stage disagree.

### `rivu index --json`

All `scan` fields plus:

```json
{"schema":1,"root":"…","projects":[…],"warnings":[],"missing":[],
 "unregistered":[],"stage_mismatch":[],
 "reconciled":[{"slug":"demo","from":"source","to":"active"}]}
```

### `rivu doctor --json`

```json
{"schema":1,"reports":[
  {"slug":"demo","name":"demo","path":"C:\\ws\\01_Active\\demo","score":78,
   "checks":[{"name":"README","ok":true,"weight":10,"detail":""}]}]}
```

With `--min-score N` the exit code is 5 when any report scores below N.

### `rivu stats --json`

```json
{"schema":1,"range":"all","total":12,"avg_health":71,"median_health":74,
 "stale":3,"missing_folder":1,"missing_map":2,"missing_readme":4,
 "by_flow":[{"name":"source","count":4},{"name":"active","count":5},…],
 "by_language":[{"name":"go","count":7},…],
 "by_health":[{"name":"90-100","count":2},{"name":"70-89","count":6},
              {"name":"50-69","count":3},{"name":"0-49","count":1}]}
```

- `range` echoes `--range` (`all|7d|30d|90d|365d`).
- `by_health` bands are always present; `by_flow` follows the Flow order.
- `rivu stats --csv` prints the same numbers as a `metric,value` table
  (mutually exclusive with `--json`).

### `rivu confluence list --json`

```json
{"schema":1,"confluences":[
 {"name":"heap-stack","notes":"publication family","members":3},
 {"name":"devtools","notes":"","members":6}]}
```

`rivu confluence show CONFLUENCE --json` returns the same entry plus
the members as projects (the `rivu list --json` project shape):

```json
{"schema":1,"confluence":{"name":"heap-stack","notes":"…","members":3},
 "projects":[…]}
```

Commands **without** `--json` today: `source`, `open`, `flow`, `delta`,
`agent sync`, `config`, `dashboard`, `path`, `init`, `scan --root` text
mode, `confluence` (except `list`/`show`). Their stdout is
line-oriented text; parse those only loosely.

## Environment

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `RIVU_HOME` | Rivu home (config, database, logs); default `~/.rivu` |
| `RIVU_CONFIG` | Config file path; default `<home>/config.toml` |
| `NO_COLOR` | Any value disables colour (same as `--no-color`) |

Logs: `<home>/logs/rivu.log` — JSON lines, rotated at 1 MB, three
generations kept, `-v` adds debug records.
